post_title: Anthropic announced 1M token context at standard pricing and a $100 million partner network investment, while Mistral unveiled a 675B parameter MoE model, accelerating competition in AI inference costs and enterprise deployment.

sections.title: Claude 1M Token Context at Standard Pricing — Complete Elimination of Long-Context Premium
sections.lead: Anthropic began offering 1M (million) token context for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 at standard pricing on March 13. Previously, requests exceeding 200K tokens incurred a 2x surcharge, but now uniform pricing applies across the entire 1M window.[2

sections.title: Anthropic Invests $100 Million in Claude Partner Network  Expanding Enterprise Deployment Ecosystem
sections.lead: Anthropic committed $100 million in early 2026 funding to support partner companies adopting Claude. These funds are allocated to education, technical support, and joint marketing, with plans to expand the partner-facing team by 5x.

sections.title: Mistral 3 Released — Open MoE Model Up to 675B Parameters Under Apache 2.0 License
sections.lead: Mistral AI released the Mistral 3 model family, with the flagship Mistral Large 3 employing a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture with 41B active parameters out of 675B total parameters. All models are distributed under Apache 2.0 license with NVID
